shots.action: Night sky. A four-engined bomber seen from just behind and above its tail, its right wing and fuselage on fire, flame streaming back past the open rear turret. A small figure rolls backwards out of the turret, arms and legs wide, and drops away under the tail
shots.camera: Close behind the tail, sinking with him

shots.action: Close on the gunner in the bare frame of the turret: he twists round to look at the fire in the fuselage behind him, then back out at the night, eyes wide, mouth open
shots.camera: Close, just outside the guns, easing in

shots.action: Inside the fuselage: the parachute pack in its rack, burning, the scorch spreading. A gloved hand reaches in for it and is jerked back from the heat
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter, easing in

shots.action: From beside the tail: he lets go of the guns and goes over backwards out of the turret, eyes shut, legs coming over his head, into the dark
shots.camera: Side on, tilting down after him

shots.action: A crow in a long coat is falling beside him, wings out, hat brim low, eyes half shut. He looks across at the man tumbling behind him, then at us, and speaks. The bomber burns above them
shots.camera: Three-quarter on Rook, level, drifting in

shots.action: From below: a dark twin-engined fighter under the bomber's belly, tracer going up in a line into the right wing; the wing flashes and catches
shots.camera: Low and behind, looking up, closing

shots.action: The wing goes up: fire bursts out of the inner engine and runs back along the fuselage, torn metal flying off into the slipstream
shots.camera: Off the right wingtip, pushing in

shots.action: From above: one small figure on his back in the open sky, arms and legs trailing, turning slowly as he drops away towards the dark country far below
shots.camera: High above him, looking straight down, rolling

shots.action: Rook, still falling, has a notepad out and is scribbling hard: height, speed, no parachute. He looks down past it, and his eyes go wide and his beak drops
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter, easing in

shots.action: Close on the gunner, on his back in the air: he is looking straight up at the stars, eyes wide, then calm; his eyes close
shots.camera: From above his face, turning slowly

shots.action: Rook throws the notepad over his shoulder (it sails up and away), grabs his hat brim and pulls it down over his eyes
shots.camera: Close, front three-quarter

shots.action: Straight down: a pine wood under snow coming up fast, spinning
shots.camera: Top down, falling and rolling

shots.action: He comes down through the young pines: boughs snap and fly, and he goes into the drift in a burst of snow
shots.camera: Low, from the edge of the trees, tilting down with him

shots.action: From above: he lies on his back in a man-sized dent in the snow, broken boughs round him, snow sifting down. His eyes open
shots.camera: High, straight down, sinking and turning

shots.action: What he sees: a ring of pine tops, a ragged hole, stars, snow drifting down through it. Rook's head comes in over the edge, staring down, and his hat hops
shots.camera: Flat on the ground, looking straight up

shots.action: Rook crouches by him and pushes a stick down into the drift, watching how far it goes; then he looks up and points at the hole in the trees, eyes wide. The man turns his head to watch him
shots.camera: Low three-quarter from the gap in the trees

shots.action: He sits up, holds both hands up in front of his face, opens and shuts them, then pats down his legs, eyes wide, mouth open
shots.camera: Medium close, front, easing in

shots.action: He gets to his feet; one knee gives and he goes back down into the snow, wincing. Rook flinches beside him, hat hopping, both wings half out to catch him
shots.camera: Three-quarter, chest height

shots.action: Over his shoulder: two men in caps and long coats come through the trees with a storm lantern and stop when its light finds him. He lifts an arm
shots.camera: Behind him, looking down the lane between the trees

shots.action: A bare room: a desk under a lamp, a wall map, a man in a hat and dark coat behind the desk, another standing. The gunner sits facing them with a dressing round his head. Rook stands by the wall map, arms folded, brim low
shots.camera: Wide from the door, tracking in

shots.action: Close on the man behind the desk: he throws himself back in his chair and laughs, shoulders shaking; the one behind him laughs too
shots.camera: Close, from the gunner's side of the desk

shots.action: Rook by the wall map, arms folded, hat brim down, nodding along with them, then looking over at the gunner
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter, easing in

shots.action: Over the gunner's shoulder: the man in the hat comes to his feet, bangs the desk and points straight at him, brows down
shots.camera: Over the shoulder, pushing in

shots.action: A chalk drawing of what they suspected: a figure with a spade under the pines, burying a bundle of parachute. A question mark
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: Close on the gunner: he leans in and points past them, level and sure, speaking. Behind him Rook unfolds his arms and puts a hand to his beak
shots.camera: Close, across the desk, easing in

shots.action: Grey daylight in the same wood: the two men in caps wade through the snow towards the dent. Rook is there already, pointing down at something in the snow
shots.camera: Low, from the second gap in the trees

shots.action: The harness he took off, found in the snow. Rook lifts it by one strap and turns it to the light: the two lifting straps are still folded flat against it, never pulled out. He taps his beak, and his eyes go wide
shots.camera: Low, rising and closing on Rook and the harness

shots.action: A snowfield: the burnt tail of the bomber, thin smoke. One man kneels at a metal container lying open in the snow; the other stands over him
shots.camera: Medium wide, tracking in

shots.action: The breath before: inside the container, the parachute pack, charred, never opened, its metal handle still in its pocket. A gloved finger comes in and points at it
shots.camera: Very close, easing in

shots.action: The same desk, later: a man in a cap writes a sheet out, then brings a stamp down on it. The gunner leans in to watch; Rook comes round behind the desk and bends over it to read, and his eyes go wide
shots.camera: High from the door, craning down and in

shots.action: The sheet itself, typed: investigated and corroborated by the German authorities; fell 18,000 feet without a parachute; true in all respects
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: The gunner holds the sheet in both hands, reads it, looks up, and smiles a little
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter

shots.action: Rook has the sheet now. He reads down it, and his hat leaves his head; a feather comes loose and drifts off
shots.camera: Close, front three-quarter, easing in

shots.action: Early light. Four plain white headstones in a row on mown grass. Rook stands beside them with his hat off and held at his side, and lowers his head
shots.camera: Tracking along the row towards Rook, sinking

shots.action: Dawn in the pine wood, under the hole in the trees. Rook puts his hat back on, tugs the brim, and looks up through the gap
shots.camera: Low, pushing in

shots.action: Rook's case board, a plank of pine: a photograph of the man in the dent in the snow, 18,000 FEET, NO PARACHUTE, TRUE
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: Back to the first picture: the burning bomber and the small figure at its tail, played back to its first frame
shots.camera: The opening framing
